test_description: Verify 'Last-Write-Wins' conflict resolution logic when device reconnects after offline edits
business_risk: Critical - Data loss or corruption destroys user trust
preconditions: User logged in; Device offline; Server record exists at T1
test_steps: 1. Fetch Book A (Server State T1); 2. Enable Airplane Mode; 3. Update Book A progress locally (Client State T2); 4. Disable Airplane Mode; 5. Trigger Sync Worker
expected_result: If T2 > T1, Server accepts update. Local queue clears. UI reflects T2.
test_data_needs: Pre-seeded User Library items; Mocked Network Interceptor

test_description: Validate Premium Tier activation via App Store Server Notification (Webhook)
business_risk: Critical - Revenue loss and customer support spikes
preconditions: Backend Webhook Endpoint Active; Sandbox User Account
test_steps: 1. Simulate purchase in Sandbox Env; 2. Wait for Apple/Google Server Notification; 3. Verify Backend processes webhook; 4. Verify Database User Role = 'Premium'

environment_requirements: Staging accessible to public internet (or ngrok)

test_description: Verify RAG Pipeline Latency and Fallback mechanism under load
business_risk: Medium - Poor UX due to long wait times
preconditions: OpenSearch Index Populated; OpenAI API Key Configured
test_steps: 1. Send 50 concurrent recommendation requests; 2. Measure P95 latency; 3. Simulate OpenAI Timeout (>5s); 4. Verify Fallback results
expected_result: P95 < 2s (Optimized) or Fallback triggered gracefully. No 500 errors.
success_criteria: Circuit Breaker trips correctly; Latency thresholds met
